arStrings.szText: He was Deckard’s great-grandfather removed, or what-have-you. Deckard took after him, but...Jered was a bit of a shady character, to be honest.
There’s this story about Jered. Apparently a plague rolled through his village when he was a kid. And where everyone else died...he and his family survived.
Can’t prove it, but...I think he might’ve made a bargain with something bigger than himself. Got in over his head, got the Vizjerei’s attention, and got recruited then and there.
